explication: pg_textsearch is a PostgreSQL BM25 full-text search index extension. Users create a BM25 index, then query it with ranked `<@>` scans or Boolean `@@` filtering; the runtime builds and maintains searchable memtable/segment data and scores candidates. The README documents the principal features, while source-index references support several internal connections. Some implementation files were not sampled, so undocumented runtime links are omitted rather than inferred.
